shots.title: Vienna from above
shots.idea: Open on the whole city seen from above. A heat map builds up district by district and shows where Vienna overheats in summer. The camera settles on the dense inner west around Westbahnhof, our case study.
shots.data: Heat map: surface temperature or heat-vulnerability data (source to confirm)

shots.title: Westbahnhof: sun & shade
shots.idea: The same area as an isometric model: today's Gründerzeit blocks first, then the Raumpark at +46 m: a branching deck that grows along the streets. A summer day runs as a time-lapse while the sun moves along its arc and the deck's shadow sweeps across streets and courtyards.
shots.data: Sun position for Vienna (calculated) · 3D model of the area

shots.title: Westbahnhof: wind
shots.idea: Same camera, new layer: wind particles run through the streets and over the deck. Channelled jets and sheltered corners become visible, and the deck level turns out windier than the street.
shots.camera: Same isometric view, gentle push-in to street level
shots.data: CFD results or schematic flow (to decide)

shots.title: Window & model, side by side
shots.idea: Left: the view out of a flat's window, with light and shade moving through the room over the day. Right: the isometric sun study with that window marked. Both run in sync, so the abstract model meets everyday experience.
shots.graphics: Split frame · shared clock · window marker
shots.data: Same sun data · one reference flat / window

shots.title: Use: culture
shots.idea: The whole deck in isometric view. The culture volumes rise out of the deck and light up in their colour, while all other uses stay neutral boxes: pavilions and event space at the western intersection.
shots.camera: Same isometric view of the whole deck, one use in colour, plan in the corner
shots.data: Programme and capacity of the culture zone

shots.title: Use: health & wellbeing
shots.idea: Same view, next use: the health & wellbeing volumes (sport, pool, wellbeing) rise on the eastern platforms.
shots.camera: Same isometric view of the whole deck, one use in colour, plan in the corner

shots.title: Use: residential
shots.idea: Same view: the residential volumes, the tallest boxes on the deck, rise on the central platform and show that people can live up here too.
shots.camera: Same isometric view of the whole deck, one use in colour, plan in the corner

shots.title: Use: green areas
shots.idea: Same view: low green boxes spread along the arms of the deck as planted areas. It hands over directly to the solar diagram that follows.
shots.camera: Same isometric view of the whole deck, one use in colour, plan in the corner
shots.data: Planting concept, green area in m²

shots.title: Greenery & solar income
shots.kicker: Diagram · heat map on the deck
shots.idea: A diagram over the whole deck: a heat map of how much sun each part receives over the year, with the use volumes casting their shade. From it follows where planting thrives, where shade-loving planting belongs, and where PV pays off, with the share of each shown as bars.
shots.camera: Top-down / isometric diagram, heat map sweeps in
shots.graphics: Solar heat map · legend · share bars · PV
shots.data: Yearly sun on the deck (calculated) · planting and PV assumptions

shots.title: Layers & key figures
shots.idea: The model separates into its layers (city, structure, deck, use volumes) while the key figures count up. A closing image that also works as a still for print.
